measured_bottleneck.cause: A second full three-block transformer is loaded only to select one of ten task routes.

hypothesis: A small prompt classifier trained from the already segregated search-only capability labels can preserve the v39 route decisions needed for English quality without duplicating the English transformer substrate.
successor_gates: The exact successor passes physical sparse-execution and canonical identity checks.
The exact successor re-passes all 1,400 locked functional observations with every capability at least 0.80, source-passing retention at least 0.90, and zero collapse.
Every simultaneously loaded neural graph is counted for active memory.
The exact successor has lower active model memory and lower peak RSS than the optimized CPU transformer.
The exact successor is at least 2x faster than the optimized CPU transformer on the 100-distinct-prompt, 20-repeated-observation paired benchmark with bootstrap lower bound at least 2x.
One genuinely cold request measures load, time to first output, and total latency without a probe request.
The source teacher is absent at inference and incremental KV state remains persistent.
decision_rule: Reject the one compact router on any search-holdout gate. If it passes, package one v40 successor and run the unchanged physical, identity, full-quality, CPU throughput, cold TTFT, and RSS gates. Do not tune width, steps, seed, labels, or thresholds from the result.
